notes: Frozen semantic interpretation benchmark. 'dev' may be inspected while developing; 'test' is held-out and must only be run to report results, never used to add rules or exemplars. Keys: q=query, ctx=active conversation entity, ent=acceptable primary entities ([] = no entity), multi=entities required for MULTI_ENTITY, scope=acceptable scopes, aspect=acceptable aspects (null = not graded), clarify='ok' (clarification is an acceptable outcome) or 'must' (clarification is the only correct outcome). v1.1.0 adds 'test2': a second held-out split written after the first test run, used to validate post-test fixes. v1.2.0 adds dev aspect items (entity named inside an aspect question) for calibration. Clients/case-study questions also accept scope CLIENTS_SCOPE (canonical name for company-wide client listings). v1.3.0 (2026-09-29): dev items for v3 failure categories; hospital/clinic items relabelled to clarification/out-of-domain per the Pharma OS content decision: PARA_HC_02, PARA_HC_03, PARA_HC_05, PARA_HC_06, PARA_HC_07, PARA_HC_08, T_PH_07.
